design: Pre-registered 1:3 matched exploratory-confirmatory cohort of REGULAR BREAKOUT_READY cases. Features must use bars at or before T only. Outcomes must be recomputed from T+1 through T+60 minutes. Stored outcome fields are selection/audit metadata only and must never enter features.

hypotheses.statement: Higher price change over the causal 45 minutes before T predicts MFE >= 10% within the following 60 minutes among active READY cases.
Distance to resistance adds information beyond 45-minute price change, signal price, and minutes since regular open; separately test confirmed vs missed explosions.

eligibility.positive: stored MFE >=10% with stored time-to-MFE <=60 minutes

analysis_policy.multiple_testing: Holm across H1 and H2 primary tests
prohibitions: No live-bot change from this study alone
